qs.q: Which connective best fills the blank? "One idea was that stripes help zebras hide. ______, zebras live mostly on open plains, where stripes do little to hide them."
qs.why: 숨는다는 가설과 대비되는 사실이 이어지므로 However가 알맞아요.

qs.q: How does the sentence about horses in striped coats relate to the one before it?
o: It presents a view that opposes the claim
It offers evidence for the fly claim
It explains why zebras live on plains

qs.q: What is the writer's attitude toward the insect explanation?
qs.why: many researchers now believe, other benefits may exist, not completely settled 등에서 신중하게 지지하는 태도를 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: The word "avoid" in the passage is closest in meaning to ______.
qs.why: avoid landing on striped surfaces는 줄무늬 표면에 앉는 것을 피한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: How lions hunt animals on the open plains

patches.why: Q4 asked about "spot" in "easy to spot", which does not appear in the passage; replaced with a word that does (avoid).
